question: Identify the nationality of the driver who recorded the fastest lap (by milliseconds) at the most recent Monaco Grand Prix. Also, return the year and circuit name of that race.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_041 AS nationality, r.XCL_066 AS year, c.XCL_003 AS circuit_name
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
JOIN circuits c ON c.XCL_001 = r.XCL_068
WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.XCL_066 = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.XCL_066)
    FROM races r2
    WHERE r2.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  )
  AND res.XCL_085 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.XCL_085 ASC
LIMIT 1
